name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement - Cover Page
description: Cover page for the Common Paper Mutual NDA, where the parties set the purpose, term and other deal-specific details.

name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement - Standard Terms
description: Common Paper standard terms for a mutual NDA, incorporated by the cover page.

name: Cloud Service Agreement
description: Common Paper standard agreement for providing access to a cloud service (SaaS) on a subscription basis.

name: Service Level Agreement
description: Common Paper SLA covering target uptime, response times and remedies for a cloud service.

name: Data Processing Agreement
description: Common Paper DPA governing processing of personal data between a controller and a processor or subprocessor.

name: Design Partner Agreement
description: Common Paper agreement giving a design partner early access to a product in exchange for feedback.

name: Professional Services Agreement
description: Common Paper agreement for professional services performed under statements of work (SOWs).

name: Partnership Agreement
description: Common Paper agreement setting out the obligations and terms of a business partnership between two parties.

name: Business Associate Agreement
description: Common Paper BAA for handling protected health information (PHI) in line with HIPAA.

name: Software License Agreement
description: Common Paper agreement licensing software to a customer to install and use.

name: Pilot Agreement
description: Common Paper agreement for a time-limited pilot or evaluation of a product.

name: AI Addendum
description: Common Paper addendum adding terms for AI services, inputs, outputs and training to an underlying agreement.
